messages:
katie (PM): quick sync — proposing a "soft-landing choreography" for the new multi-variant routing flag rollout (rollout_routing_v3). goal: avoid full outages during regional surges; prefer graded degrade + audit trail over abrupt failovers. details below.

mike (Eng): +1. curious about exact ramping cadence and whether we auto-backoff on latency vs errors. also: do we want model-variant fallbacks or route-level shed?

sara (SRE): propose circuit triggers: p95 latency > 800ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR error rate > 1.5% over 5m OR GPU utilization > 90% cluster-wide. when tripped: immediate shed to degraded variant, alert on-call and start 10m timer for auto-rollback if metrics improve.

avni (Data): for A/B we should surface these metrics per-cohort: completion_quality (fidelity score), hallucination rate, and downstream CTR for feature. recommend we run a 1% holdback cohort first to validate quality signals.

josh (Design): UX note — when we degrade responses, users should see subtle indicator and not a hard error. plan: small inline banner "response shortened for latency" + telemetry ping. avoids user confusion.

mike (Eng): layering idea: Variant A = full model; B = quantized smaller model; C = KV-prefix cached responses; D = short-form summary generator. routing policy: prefer A, then B, then C, then D. if all fail -> preconfigured stub response.

katie (PM): sounds good. need an ops-playbook, rollout percentages, monitoring dashboard, and a decision owner. suggestion: mike owns infra rollout, avni owns metrics evaluation, sara owns circuit thresholds and runbook.

mike (Eng): proposed ramp plan (inline):
```
0% -> 0.5% (30m) -> 2% (2h) -> 10% (6h) -> 30% (24h) -> 100%
checkpoints: quality gate at each step (avni): hold or rollback on metric regressions
```

sara (SRE): add automated backoff: if p95 > 700ms or errors > 0.8% at any checkpoint, cut ramp by half and notify #oncall; if severe breach (> 1.5% errors) roll back to previous stable variant and open incident. keep traces/logs for 30 days.

release-bot: Deployment scheduled: rollout_routing_v3 -> canary window at 2026-04-02T09:00Z. (automated)

katie (PM): action items: mike -> create the flag + rollout script and toggle API (due EOD Thu); avni -> define pass/fail thresholds and dashboard tiles (due Fri); sara -> add circuit thresholds to runbook and run a tabletop (due Mon). i'll coordinate stakeholder comms and customer opt-out path. :handshake:

mike (Eng): noted, will post PR with flag naming + sample traffic slices. proposed flag name: `flag.rollout.routing_v3` and CLI toggle `redwood rollout set flag.rollout.routing_v3 --pct 2`.

avni (Data): will surface a quick metric pack (p95, error%, fidelity_delta) in the dashboard and add a derived field for cohort-level rollbacks.

sara (SRE): will add playbook snippet and a short test plan for simulated high-latency events. reach out if you want me to join the run-through.

katie (PM): great — i'll ping customers on the beta list about opt-out and expected behavior. tagging this thread for visibility. :eyes:
